name: Sipsmith London Dry Gin
base_ingredient: Neutral spirit from Sipsmith vodka distillation (second half of the heart)
production: Copper pot still; rectifying column bypassed
Base spirit hydrated to 60–65% ABV, heated to 60–65°C for 15 min then steeped 12 hours
Comes off still at ~84% ABV; reduced with Lydwell Spring water
history: 2009 | Sipsmith began in a small workshop in Hammersmith, London, founded by childhood friends Fairfax Hall and Sam Galsworthy
serve_official: Classic G&T with classic tonic and a lime wedge, or Martini (Gin Guild)
notes: Described as the first copper-still distillery in London for nearly 200 years. Gin Guild lists 11 botanical names (adds sweet orange); Difford's lists 10 with origins.
